title: Audioman Fx Result
description: Output envelope for `audioman fx --json`. Single-file runs emit one object; batch mode (`-r` over a directory) emits one JSON object per line, where success lines carry `output`/`output_rms`/`output_peak` and failure lines carry `error` instead.

output.description: Output path; present on single-file runs and batch success lines.

input_stats.description: Stats of the input signal; single-file runs only.

output_stats.description: Stats of the processed signal; single-file runs only.
